translations.web: The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.
translations.bsb: The east wind carries him away, and he is gone; it sweeps him out of his place.
translations.kjv: The east wind carrieth him away, and he departeth: and as a storm hurleth him out of his place.
